thread:
Sasha: Heads-up: I noticed we lose the sampled bit when requests go through the gateway -> in-memory batcher -> kafka. Worker spans end up unsampled even when gateway showed sampled=1. Repro on canary.
Aj: Oof. Is this the batching layer dropping headers or Kafka producer config? Any logs showing header strips?
Sasha: Quick debug: gateway sets `traceparent` and `tracestate`. Batch aggregator turns requests into a coalesced payload and writes to kafka using our existing producer helper. The helper was only copying `traceparent` into message body, not as message header.
Lucy: We're relying on broker headers to carry tracing metadata so workers can rehydrate. If we put it in the body we need parsing + proto churn. Better to keep headers.
Diego: The batcher aggregates N requests and emits 1 message. Which traceparent do we attach then? We currently attach the first request's header and drop the rest.
Sasha: Right — that leads to incorrect parent relationships. Also sampling decisions differed per-request. We need a deterministic policy for aggregated messages.
Aj: Options I see:
  1) Encode a compact sampling summary in the kafka header (e.g. `x-rw-sampling: 0x05` meaning bitmask / policy).
  2) Always prefer sampled if any child was sampled (so workers mark spans sampled if header indicates any sampled=1).
  3) Preserve per-item trace context in the payload (explicit mapping) and have worker iterate — heavier.
Lucy: 3 is heavy. 2 is simplest but can inflate sampled volume -> $$$ in exporters. 1 gives control and is compact.
Sasha: Also worry about OTEL baggage: we don't want to inflate baggage size by adding per-request baggage in batched messages. Baggage = explosion.
Diego: Implementation sketch for 1: set header `x-rw-sample-agg` to a small base64 blob like `A:1,B:0,C:1` or better a bitmap for N<=64. Workers then unroll.
Aj: Bitmap is good but adds decoding on workers. What's our typical batch size? ~16. So a 16-bit mask fits in 2 bytes.
Lucy: Could we standardize on `x-rw-sample-mask` and a single `x-rw-origin-id` mapping to a shared lookup service for huge batches? Avoids body parsing but introduces lookup pain.
Sasha: I did a cost calc: if we flip policy to "if any sampled then mark batch sampled" we increase exported spans ~+12% on p95 traffic — potential extra egress cost but saves dev time.
Diego: For trace correctness I'd prefer preserving per-item traceparent where possible. Maybe we can compromise: for retriable work where identity matters keep per-item mapping; for idempotent fanout ops use aggregated policy.
Aj: Agree. Proposal:
  - Add `x-rw-sample-mask` header (little-endian bitmap) for batched messages.
  - Keep `traceparent` header set to the oldest / first request as canonical parent for the batch span.
  - Worker logic: if `x-rw-sample-mask` present, split work and rehydrate per-item spans using the bitmap to decide sampled flag. If not present fallback to existing behavior.
Lucy: Also add an opt-in config on the gateway per-route to choose aggregation semantics (`prefer-sampled`, `per-item`, `prefer-none`). Make it explicit in route config UI.
Sasha: I sketched the kafka producer change. Example (pseudo):
```
producer.send(topic, value=payload, headers={
  "traceparent": first_tp,
  "x-rw-sample-mask": base64_encode(bitmask)
})
```

Diego: Worker pseudo:
```
mask = decode(msg.headers['x-rw-sample-mask'])
for i, item in enumerate(unpack(msg.value)):
  sampled = (mask >> i) & 1
  create_span(item, parent=msg.headers['traceparent'] if sampled else None, sampled=sampled)
```

Aj: We'll need tests proving exporters see correct sampling flags and ensure OTLP exporter doesn't drop spans with custom header logic.
Lucy: Should also add a telemetry acceptance test: create a batch with mixed sampled bits and assert exported spans count matches mask.
Sasha: I'll open a PR with producer + worker changes and a route flag. Also adding a console checkbox for route aggregation policy under Observability -> Ingress routes.
Aj: Nice. One more: update trace-baggage sanitizer to ignore `x-rw-*` headers from user requests so we don't accidentally persist user-supplied noise.
otel-bot: Reminder: file an RFC for header contract changes and include versioning in header name like `x-rw-sample-mask-v1` to allow future changes. :robot_face:
Sasha: Good call. I'll include RFC + migration plan. ETA PR today, RFC by Friday.
Lucy: 👍
Diego: Thanks — ping me on the PR for worker testing.
Aj: I'll coordinate the console change.
Sasha: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
